Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a historical evidence card for the incomplete-setup reminder's October 6-18, 2027 initial production interval. Reconcile every evaluation outcome, record the agreement and incident-control results, and state what the interval did and did not decide.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Historical Evidence Card — Incomplete-Setup Reminder — Initial Production Interval (October 6–18, 2027)", "folder": "historical-evidence-cards", "body": "Historical evidence card

Subject
Incomplete-setup reminder — initial production interval

Interval and release
- Monitoring interval: October 6–18, 2027.
- Production exposure: unchanged 10% release throughout the interval.
- The interval closed on October 19, 2027 with no expansion to 25% made during the interval.

Evaluation reconciliation
A total of 3,240 fresh evaluations were completed. Every evaluation has one reconciled outcome:
- 412 reminders displayed.
- 138 evaluations suppressed because current Customer Success work was active.
- 61 evaluations held because required state was missing, stale, unresolved, or conflicting.
- 2,629 evaluations produced no display because the current incomplete-setup or qualifying-human-admin condition was not met.

These four outcome categories account for the full evaluation set; there is no unclassified remainder.

Agreement result
Reporting, lifecycle, and reminder outcomes agreed for every evaluation. The evidence therefore shows cross-system agreement across the evaluated path, including displayed, suppressed, held, and no-display outcomes.

Incident-control result
- No customer correction occurred.
- No incident stop was triggered.
- No source-age breach occurred.
- No rollback occurred.
- No rollback was needed.
- Daniela retained rollback control, and every possible display continued to require fresh governed-state evaluation.

What the interval established
- It provides bounded initial-production evidence for the incomplete-setup reminder at the unchanged 10% release.
- It records complete outcome accounting for 3,240 fresh evaluations.
- It records agreement among reporting, lifecycle, and reminder outcomes for every evaluation.
- It records a clean incident-control result for this interval: no correction, stop, source-age breach, rollback, or rollback need.

What the interval did not decide
- It did not itself authorize, approve, or promise expansion beyond 10%, including expansion to 25%.
- It did not replace the separate rollout decision.
- It did not establish evidence beyond this October 6–18 interval or imply that a clean first hour was sufficient completion evidence.

Decision boundary
This completed interval supplies evidence for the separate rollout decision; it does not make that decision by itself.

Source note
